plan: This is a single-round auction, so there's no learning to be done from previous rounds. The optimal bidding strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction, given common knowledge of rationality, is to bid slightly below your true value. This is because bidding your true value can lead to regret if you win and pay close to your value. Bidding slightly below ensures you win only when it's truly profitable and reduces the risk of overpaying. I will bid slightly below my value of $34.
